hooks.command: b=../SPM-Optimization; [ -d "$b" ] || exit 0; d=$(date +%F); ls "$b/corpus/sessions/landlord/$d-session-"*.md >/dev/null 2>&1 || printf '{"decision":"block","reason":"No session report exists for %s in the knowledge store. Before ending, write ../SPM-Optimization/corpus/sessions/landlord/%s-session-N.md (N = next unused number for today). Write what this session LEARNED, not what it did: rules established, corrections issued against earlier claims, and what is still owed by a human. Then stop again."}' "$d" "$d"
